lines.en: I inch across the basalt
My body sits heavy
I take a step and pause
Heat rises from under my feet
I drag my steps through the ash
My shadow falls on the lava
I skirt a vent of flame
My hide is blackened by smoke
I am not rushed, and neither is the fire
I work my way down the black slope
My feet crush the pumice
I move slowly through the smoke
I lie on the hot stone
I let out a slow breath of heat
My thick hide is like armor
I glance at the vent
I paw at the ash
Lava gurgles beneath my throat.
The hard plates on my back shine
I listen to the distant rumble
I settle lower to the ground
My eyes glow in the smoke

lines.zh: 我从玄武岩堆后探头看你。
lines.en: I poke my head out from the basalt pile.
You stand too far from the fire
I turn slowly toward you
You smell cool to me
This hide can take fire
Which way did you come up
It is hot here, and you will not last

lines.zh: 你回头的时候，我已经在你身后。
lines.en: By the time you turn, I'm already behind you.
A dent stays in my hide
A crack splits my shell, and I growl.

lines.zh: 我把头一甩，岩浆溅到石上。
lines.en: I shake my head, splashing lava onto the stone.
I curl my claws in
I am still steady
This fire is hotter than you
I turn back around

lines.zh: 护甲挡住了大半，可我还是疼。
lines.en: My armor took most of it, but it still stings.

lines.zh: 你手里的草，我连看都不看。
lines.en: I don't even glance at the grass in your hand.
I sniff, it is cold
I turn my head and leave
I ease away from it
I slowly turn my face away
It is cold and tasteless
Here I eat only what is scalding
That smell... it pulls me closer.
You hit my thick hide
I did not even shift
You bounce right off
My hide is hard as stone
My heavy shell scrapes across your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞下界玄武岩。
lines.en: You hit me like you hit nether basalt.
I shift slowly aside
You hit and fell back
My hide numbs your hands
There are others by the vent
A stretch of lava lies between us
She bears the heat better than I
We lie on the hot stone together
Neither of us moves much
We need not say much
She crawled slowly into the smoke
I crawl slowly to her side
We lie side by side in the ash

lines.zh: 我用爪子把东西扒起来
lines.en: I rake it up with a claw
This stone is still warm
I look and set it down
I bite it, it cracks
I roll it along in front of me
I leave it in the ash
I hook it over with a forepaw
I press it into the ash
You stepped into my hot ground

lines.zh: 我拖着身子在玄武岩上走。
lines.en: I drag myself over the basalt.
You cannot stay here long
I shift one step at you

lines.zh: 我背上的裂口亮起来，朝你转。
lines.en: The cracks on my back glow as I turn toward you.
This patch is mine
You can still go back
My forepaw is up

lines.zh: 你身上的凉气我闻得到
lines.en: I can smell the cold on you
I drop my head and lean forward

lines.zh: 我的爪子在灰里抓了抓
lines.en: My claws scrape in the ash
You are backing toward the vent
I do not run, I walk steadily
My hide takes the hits for me
You cannot get around this basalt
I wait for the heat to drive you off
I close the gap slowly
The stone under you is hot
You can hear my breathing
My claws sink into the ash
I keep facing you
I move along the black stone
I will not yield this path
I ram you with my shoulder
My tail sweeps your legs
That carried all my weight
You are shoved straight back
My paw comes down again

lines.zh: 我的爪子在你身上刮过
lines.en: My claws rake across you
You block, and give half a step
I am not quick, but I am heavy
I press in again
My weight bears down on you
I sweep you aside with a paw
Something moves beneath the hot stone
I crawl out of the smoke

lines.zh: 我的影子先落在熔岩上
lines.en: My shadow lands on the lava first
Ash blows clear of the vent

lines.zh: 熔岩顺着我的背甲往下淌。
lines.en: Lava runs down the shell on my back.
A crack opens in the ground
I come out of the basalt heap
The heat wraps around me
I shake the ash off my back
The stone under me glows red
I squeeze up out of the crack
A sound comes from the vent

lines.zh: 火裹住我，我只是热了一点
lines.en: Fire wraps me and I only warm up
The ground shakes when I land

lines.zh: 水浇在我皮上，冒起白烟
lines.en: Water hits my hide and hisses off
The blast slides me along

lines.zh: 一支箭弹在我的硬皮上
lines.en: An arrow bounces off my hide
Magic spreads out over my hide
There is little to eat on this hot ground

lines.zh: 雷击打得我背上的皮一亮
lines.en: The strike lights up my back
I am still steaming as I fall
